podcast.title: Breakup due to Parental Divorce
podcast.body: Similar to Dave Grohl's first band, Nameless also broke up when Nick Christie's parents divorced, and he moved away with his mother. "Nameless broke up when Nick moved away with his mom."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Post-HG Hancock Formation
podcast.body: This band was formed by Dave Grohl and Nick Christie after the HG Hancock band broke up, following Larry Hinkel's move. "This led to a new venture with a kid named Nick Christie who lived a few blocks away."

podcast.title: Self-Referential Name
podcast.body: The band was notably known simply as "Nameless," a name that was ironically clever according to the transcript. "That band eventually became known as, and this is clever, not, they were known as nameless."

xref.title: Ghost (Sweden, 1996) – Papa Emeritus = Tobias Forge; Nameless Ghouls; Arena-Level Success Despite Satanic Imagery
xref.body: Ghost came together in Sweden in 1996 and became a worldwide phenomenon filling arenas. The only named member is the frontman Papa Emeritus (stage name of Tobias Forge), who dresses like a Pope from hell and cycles through different character names (Cardinal Copia, Papa Emeritus IV). All other band members are called Nameless Ghouls, each representing an ancient element (fire, water, wind, earth, plus ether). Rumored past Ghouls have included Dave Grohl. The satanic imagery has caused problems in the US Bible Belt. Their sound is a blend of hard metal, arena rock, doom metal, psych, symphonic metal, and gothic rock. "Ghost is hard metal, metal, arena rock, do metal, psych, symphonic metal, gothic rock, and more."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Papa Emeritus and Nameless Ghouls Lineup
xref.body: The band's lineup consists of a frontman, Papa Emeritus, and a group of "nameless ghouls" who wear virtually identical costumes and face masks. "Papa Emeritus is up front while all the nameless ghouls appear in pretty much identical costumes and face masks. In fact, the lineup is listed as Papa Emeritus IV and a group of nameless ghouls, one of whom may or may not have temporarily included deep role."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Possible Nameless Ghoul
